blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Mindoro Artists Initiative (MAI) has joined calls for the immediate release of a cultural worker who was arrested six months ago. Charlize “Ceeka” Garzon was nabbed following an armed encounter between government troops and suspected New People’s Army (NPA) fighters at San Jose town in Occidental Mindoro. She was taken into custody on March 29, the same day a clash erupted at Sitio Salafay, Barangay Monteclaro between elements of the Army’s 68th Infantry Battalion and alleged NPA rebels.
